tools.name: search_wines
tools.description: Searches the NEVINI wine catalog by free text and filters (type, country, region, grape, verified price range, availability). query matches name, winery, grape, region, country, type and vintage; use type, country, region, grape, min_price_eur, max_price_eur and sort for style and budget, and food f

tools.name: get_wine
tools.description: Returns one wine by slug, numeric id, name or wine URL: description, grapes, taste notes, serving temperature, rating, every bottle size with its variant_id, live price and availability, and related wines. taste lists every taste note; food_pairing is the pairing sentence quoted from the description

tools.name: get_catalog_overview
tools.description: Returns an overview of the NEVINI range: wine counts per type, country and category page, the most common grapes, the top selection and the verified price range. Use it to see what the range covers; use search_wines to find wines and get_wine for one wine.

tools.name: get_store_info
tools.description: Returns NEVINI store facts: company and contact details, contact availability, pickup in Maastricht, shipping rates, countries and delivery times, returns, age policy, payment, hospitality services, policy URLs and how ordering through this server works. Use it for questions about delivery, pickup,

tools.name: create_cart
tools.description: Creates a new Shopify cart with wine variants (variant_id from search_wines or get_wine) and returns cart_id, the items with live prices, the subtotal and checkout_url. No order is placed and no payment is taken here; checkout_url opens the checkout on shop.nevini.wine. Requires buyer_is_18_or_older

tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.description: Adds wine variants to an existing cart; quantities add up with lines already in the cart. Returns the updated cart and checkout_url. No order is placed and no payment is taken here; checkout_url opens the checkout on shop.nevini.wine. Use create_cart when there is no cart yet and update_cart to chan

tools.name: update_cart
tools.description: Sets the quantity of existing cart lines by line_id; quantity 0 removes a line. Returns the updated cart and checkout_url. No order is placed and no payment is taken here; checkout_url opens the checkout on shop.nevini.wine. line_id comes from create_cart, add_to_cart or get_cart; use add_to_cart fo

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Returns the current lines, live prices, subtotal and checkout_url of a cart. No order is placed and no payment is taken here; checkout_url opens the checkout on shop.nevini.wine. It changes nothing; use it to show the cart again or to look up line_id for update_cart.
